# Shift Browser

> Shift Browser is a productivity platform that centralizes multiple accounts and applications into a unified workspace, offering guides, tools, and strategies for remote work, email management, and digital wellness.

Shift Browser provides comprehensive resources for managing productivity across Google Workspace, Office 365, and dozens of third-party integrations. The site combines practical how-to guides with strategic articles on work-life balance, remote collaboration, and workflow optimization for modern distributed teams.

## Key Topics

- Shift Browser
- Productivity Tools

## Productivity & Workflow Tools

- [53 Workflow Automation Tools to Boost Productivity](https://shift.com/guides/productivity/workflow-automation-tools): Comprehensive list of 53 workflow automation tools including ClickUp for productivity.
- [The Top 13 Tools to Maximize Email Productivity](https://shift.com/guides/productivity/email-productivity-tools): Comparison of 13 email productivity tools including Sanebox and Polymail for inbox management.
- [The 12 Best Video Conferencing Apps for Remote Meetings](https://shift.com/guides/working-from-home/best-video-conferencing-apps): Comparison guide of 12 video conferencing apps with features and pricing for remote work.
- [How to Avoid Overstacking Your Tech Stack](https://shift.com/blog/how-to-avoid-overstacking-your-tech-stack): Article on managing bloated tech stacks and tool consolidation for business efficiency.

## Email & Gmail Management

- [Gmail Hacks Guaranteed to Make Email Management Easier](https://shift.com/guides/google-workspace/gmail-hacks): Tips and hacks for Gmail email management across Google Workspace and multiple accounts.
- [How to Mark and Manage Spam Mails in Gmail](https://shift.com/guides/google-workspace/how-to-mark-and-manage-spam-gmail): Guide for spam management and inbox organization in Gmail with Google Workspace.

## Remote Work & Team Collaboration

- [Everything You Need to Know about Shift for Teams](https://shift.com/blog/shift-for-teams): Overview of Shift for Teams product for team productivity and workflow management.
- [How Virtual Teams Communicate Effectively](https://shift.com/guides/working-from-home/how-virtual-teams-communicate-effectively): Guide for remote team communication strategies and management in virtual work environments.
- [Create a Group Conversation on Google Hangouts](https://shift.com/guides/google-workspace/create-google-hangouts-group-conversation): Tutorial for creating group conversations in Google Hangouts via Shift Browser.

## Account & Calendar Management

- [Manage Multiple Calendly Logins](https://shift.com/guides/multiple-accounts/manage-multiple-calendly-logins): How-to guide for managing multiple Calendly accounts via Shift Browser.

## Digital Wellness & Work-Life Balance

- [How Daylight Savings Steals Your Focus and How to Stay Productive](https://shift.com/guides/deep-work/how-daylight-savings-steals-your-focus-and-how-to-stay-productive): Guide on managing productivity during daylight savings time and optimizing circadian rhythm.
